stem: Which of the following description about the monitoring minimal residual disease in ALL and AML is wrong?

options.A: Apart from t(15;17) and RUNX1–RUNX1T1 and CBFB–MYH11, currently RUNX1 is the best-validated molecular marker for MRD assessment in AML.
options.B: There are several studies showing that FLT3-ITD is a highly prognostic biomarkers while measured after induction chemotherapy.
options.C: Regarding the NGS MRD for patients with AML, germline mutations (ex. ANKRD26, CEBPA, DDX41, RUNX1, and TP53) are noninformative as NGS-MRD markers.
options.D: Most frequent recurrent reciprocal translocations are in ALL t(9;22)(q34;q11) (BCR-ABL1), t(12;21)(p13;q23) (ETV6-RUNX1), and t(4;11)(q21;q22) (MLL-AFF1) with age stage associated preponderance in adults, childhood, and infant ALL, respectively.
